s.how: Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty. Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with the brown butter and flaky salt and fill striped paper bags.

s.note: Danny's New York, outside the Pandora
s.how: Boil 4 large potatoes and mash with 1 onion fried soft in 30g butter, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8, put a mound of potato on each, fold up and pinch closed. Brush with 1 beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with yellow mustard.

m.how: Dry-brine 2 thick rib eyes overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear the steaks, finish at 200C to 54C inside and rest. Top with 60g garlic butter, slice to share and load the potatoes with sour cream and 150g crispy bacon.

w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four bowls, pour over the hot fudge and top with whipped cream, a handful of salted peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the kid in the cinema seat
d.how: Add 500ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder and 4 tbsp malted milk powder to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top with whipped cream and a handful of crushed chocolate malt balls. Serve with wide straws and long spoons.
